ontology.name: French-Door Refrigerator
ontology.description: CG-7 candidate canonical graph — functional and architecture-agnostic. NOT frozen. No component earns canonical status from this skeleton; R1–R3 manual evidence required before rev1.
ontology.candidateNote: Design principles and relationship vocabulary only. All listed concepts are unvalidated hypotheses pending Whirlpool → Samsung → LG discovery.

designPrinciples: Model functional refrigeration behavior — not physical sealed-system topology or manufacturer-specific board architectures.
Separate power, control, user interface, temperature control, cooling actuation, airflow distribution, defrost, and optional features (ice/water) diagnostically.
Compressor, fans, dampers, and heaters may be platform implementations of higher-level functional roles — do not assume physical part names belong in canonical layer.
Compartment-specific temperature sensing (fresh food vs freezer) may be canonical functional split or platform implementation — requires multi-manufacturer evidence.
Defrost orchestration (adaptive interval, heater, termination sensor) may warrant a functional defrost domain distinct from individual heaters/sensors — scrutinize before freeze.
Ice maker and water dispenser are optional feature domains — defer unless independently evidenced across manuals.
Manufacturer-specific implementations (Jazz board, EM2Y60 compressor, damper motor, bimetal naming) belong in overlays — not canonical expansion by default.
Door authorization (light switch / switch clusters) is distinct from compartment cooling paths when procedure evidence supports the split.
Nothing in this file modifies frontend/components/diagnostics/knowledge/canonical/ — calibration artifact only.
